notes.title: v1.3.2 - Hotfix
notes.content:
Hello! Just a quick patch to resolve some issues.

[list]
[*] Fixed some item description bugs
[*] Buffed cross and beam staffs
[*] Added a new character and achievement
[*] Made mob pathfinding and movement smoother - the game should feel more responsive
[*] Fixed a bug with mob discovery
[*] Fixed a bug in master mode that caused missingno-type monsters to spawn
[/list]

Thank you all for playing!

notes.title: v1.3.0 - Quality of Life
notes.content:
Hello!
I've finished a small patch to the game that should improve the overall gameplay experience!

Change notes:
[list]
[*] Added a new option - swap X and S keys
[*] Added one new monster, one new item
[*] Made it so main menu music fades out when you start playing
[*] Fixed a major pathfinding bug
[*] Updated to Godot 4.4
[/list]

Please reach out to me if you encounter any issues with this build! I've done my best to test it, but I can only do so much. Because of the update to Godot 4.4 from 4.3, there may be unexpected behavior. If that happens, let me know, and I'll start working on it!

Thank you all for playing Dungeon-Dungeon! I really appreciate it and it is an honor to be able to work with you.

notes.title: v1.2.0 - Holiday Update
notes.content:
Hello!
I just threw together a small update for the holidays. If you play during December or January, you'll get a new main menu design, and unlock a new playable character! (If you're reading this in the future, you can switch your computer's date to have the same effect)

Changes:
[list]
[*] New Holiday main menu
[*] New character
[*] 2 New Items
[*] Update to Godot 4.3
[/list]

As always, let me know if there are any bugs or feature requests!

Have a great holiday season,
- ChillCash

notes.title: Version v1.1.0 Out
notes.content:
Good news!

I've just released version 1.1.0, which adds the following:
[list]
[*] A new monster on every layer, as well as new items
[*] Master mode, an even harder difficulty
[*] Boss monster drops (Only on Master mode)
[*] Music volume adjustments
[/list]

I've taken care to make sure every new monster fills in gaps that were missing earlier. Hopefully even more diverse builds will be possible for your runs.

Lastly, I just want to say thank you to everyone who has played Dungeon-Dungeon. A few days ago Dungeon-Dungeon officially became profitable, which means I'll be able to continue making even more games. I appreciate all the support and feedback I have gotten.

I hope you enjoy the update!

notes.title: Prerelease Update
notes.content:
Dungeon-Dungeon is in the last stages before release. I'm mostly working on quality of life improvements as well as music and bugfixes. I've made some changes to make the process of learning the game a bit easier.

I've pushed a few updates to the live game:
[list]
[*] Added new inspect for mobs
[*] Fixed some movement bugs
[*] Adjusted base difficulty settings
[*] Added more music!
[/list]

Thank you all for following along and I'm looking forward to release!

notes.title: Minor Improvements
notes.content:
I've just pushed a minor update that includes some quality of life changes. 
[list]
[*] Traps no longer appear on the first few floors.
[*] Attacks are now logged and sent as a message.
[*] Updated discovered floor texture.
[*] Added ability to move with mouse.
[*] Changed key bindings of some actions -> Check tutorial
[*] Fixed a duplication glitch... oops!
[/list]

notes.title: Alpha v6.0 Live!
notes.content:
Alpha v6.0 is now live, and has the following features:
- Dynamic mapping of areas you've already explored
- Improved combat animations
- Attack particle effects
- An updated tutorial with term definitions
- Improved floor transitions
- A limited item pool for the first 10 floors

notes.title: Alpha v5.0
notes.content:
Added lots of items in every category. Some new mob drops, fish to catch, and things to discover on the ground.
Added some new achievements.
Added two new characters.
Added five new stats.
Changed the way info is printed to screen.
Added the bestest boy.
Added a new weapon.
Press "f" to use items on the ground.
Fixed some bugs.

notes.title: Alpha v5.0 in progress
notes.content:
With any luck, Alpha v5.0 should be out in the next few days. 
What I'm working on:
- New items (fish, floor loot, mob drops)
- 5 new stats
- 2 new unlockable characters (you can already see their achievements on Steam... also has hints at two of the new stats)
- Quality of life changes (biggest one is pressing f to use [i]any[/i] item, including those on the floor)

notes.title: Alpha v4.0
notes.content:
Alpha v4.0 is live, and with it comes many quality of life features!
In general, check out the updated tutorial and mob catalog. The tutorial has information about new hotkeys added to the game.

Changelog
- Added custom mouse cursor
- Added player character display in main menu
- Reworked mob catalog
- Reworked tutorial
- Added item use hotkey
- Added item drop hotkey
- Added item pickup hotkey
- Added hotkeys for inventory slots
- Slightly changed fishing (looking for feedback)
